record.original_question: Let A = direct sum_{i=0}^c A_i be a standard graded Artinian Gorenstein algebra over a field whose characteristic is zero or greater than c, with embedding dimension n. Suppose the symmetric group S_n acts on A by permuting the variables. Must A have the strong Lefschetz property?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero or of characteristic strictly greater than a positive integer $c$. Let $A = \bigoplus_{i=0}^{c} A_i$ be a standard graded Artinian Gorenstein $K$-algebra with socle degree $c$ and embedding dimension $n$ (so $A$ is a quotient of the polynomial ring $K[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ by a homogeneous ideal, with $\dim_K A_0 = \dim_K A_c = 1$). Assume that the symmetric group $S_n$ acts on $A$ as a graded $K$-algebra by permuting the variables $x_1,\dots,x_n$.

Recall that $A$ is said to have the strong Lefschetz property (SLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A_1$ such that, for every pair of integers $0 \le i \le j \le c$, the multiplication map $\times \ell^{\,j-i} : A_i \to A_j$ has maximal rank (i.e., is either injective or surjective).

Question: Must every such $A$ have the strong Lefschetz property?
artifact.category_tag: Lefschetz properties of Artinian Gorenstein algebras
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether every standard graded Artinian Gorenstein algebra (in characteristic 0 or large) admitting a permutation action of the symmetric group on its variables must satisfy the strong Lefschetz property appears to be an open problem. Recent related work (2024–2025) establishes SLP in special cases — e.g., for Gorenstein algebras generated by relative invariants, for compressed Gorenstein algebras whose dual generators are complete symmetric polynomials, and weaker (WLP) results for general symmetric ideals — but no source found resolves the general question.

status_evidence.title: The Strong Lefschetz Property of Gorenstein Algebras Generated by Relative Invariants
status_evidence.snippet: Studies SLP for Gorenstein algebras arising from invariant theory, addressing special cases of group actions rather than the general symmetric-group permutation question.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial / special-case results on SLP under group actions are available in the recent literature.

status_evidence.title: General Symmetric Ideals
status_evidence.snippet: General symmetric ideals satisfy the Weak Lefschetz Property under the natural symmetric group action.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work establishes WLP (not SLP) for related symmetric-action settings, indicating SLP remains unresolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Waring and cactus ranks and Strong Lefschetz Property for annihilators of symmetric forms
status_evidence.snippet: Treats SLP for annihilators of symmetric forms (compressed Gorenstein algebras with symmetric dual generators).
status_evidence.claim: Special families of symmetric Gorenstein algebras are known to satisfy SLP, but the general question is not settled.
